title: [Decision] Actions taken while impersonating a user are recorded only under that user
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer, verbatim: 「S2：管理员模拟员工时做的修改，事后查不出是谁做的，这个要立决策卡，评估开发方案」 (2026-11-05). Business explanation is in the session; this card holds the options.

## The question

When an administrator impersonates an employee and changes data, how should the record show who really did it?

Governing text:
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts:476`: the impersonation confirm says "actions will be logged".
- Banner: 「您正在以 {{user}} 的身份操作 —— 所有操作都会记录为该用户。」
- ADR-0090 D10 rule 4 (dual attribution) and ADR-0118 D1/D5 (`actor` keeps two values; "which non-user acted" is answered by an added attribution field).

## Measured

On `main` `b7075d9908`, a ticket created in an impersonation session:

| Where | Records |
|:--|:--|
| `sys_audit_log` row | `user_id` and `actor` both the impersonated user; `ip_address` and `metadata` empty |
| `sys_activity` | 王工 |
| Record | `created_by` the impersonated user |
| Sign-in rows | The session event does name the administrator (`plugin-audit/src/auth-event-audit.ts`) |

So an investigation can see that an impersonation session existed, and cannot see which writes came from it. No administrator appears on the write.

Existing shapes to build on, read at `dfafae8132`:
- `audit-writers.ts` writes `metadata: { performed_by, on_behalf_of }` for a delegated agent write, present only on such writes.
- `ExecutionContext.attributedUserId` is the precedent for an attribution-only field, which the authorization path never reads.
- `service-print/src/print-routes.ts:176` refuses a print in an impersonation session, so reading `impersonatedBy` from the session already has a consumer.
- `rest-server.ts:3072` notes that impersonation resolves to the impersonated user at the session level.

## Options and development cost

The seat's estimates come from reading the code; nothing was prototyped.

- **A. Record the administrator on each write, in the existing metadata shape.** Add an attribution-only context field filled from `session.impersonatedBy`. The audit writer adds `metadata.impersonated_by`, and `sys_activity` carries the same. The audit log and the record timeline show 「Dev Admin 代王工操作」. `user_id`, `created_by` and permissions are unchanged. No schema change. Small to medium: spec, REST context, audit writers, console display. Limit: a metadata text column cannot be filtered well, so "everything this administrator did while impersonating" needs the session window or a scan.
- **B. A first-class `impersonated_by` column on `sys_audit_log` and `sys_activity`.** Same display as A, plus a real filter. Medium: adds schema, migration and an index on both tables, and old rows stay empty. It is a second attribution shape next to `performed_by`.
- **C. Make impersonation read-only.** Refuse writes in an impersonation session, as the print door already refuses. Attribution stops being a question. Small on the server, and one choke point must cover every write path. Support loses the ability to reproduce and fix a problem as the user, which is the common reason to impersonate. Needs a console state explaining the refusal.
- **D. Only correct the wording.** The confirm says plainly that writes are recorded as the user. Almost no cost, and the gap stays.

## Recommendation: A

四轴（中文）：

- **实际业务需求：** 客户投诉、内部追责和合规审计都要回答「这是本人还是管理员做的」。管理员替员工排查和修数据又是模拟功能的日常用途，所以 C 会砍掉主要价值。A 和 B 都能回答问题。需要「按管理员查全部代操作」的频率更低，可以先靠模拟会话的时间窗定位。
- **项目长远合理性：** A 沿用代理写入已有的双重归属形状，全平台只有一种写法；B 多一种形状，但查询更好。将来审计查询确实需要时，可以从 A 升到 B，那时再加列和回填。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错：** 归属字段只用于记录、不参与授权，沿用 `attributedUserId` 的不变量，AI 不会误把它当主体。C 要覆盖所有写入口，漏一个就是静默缺口。
- **创业阶段不扩散：** A 不加列、不加迁移，只是把已有事实写下来。

**A's sub-points to confirm:**
- Should the timeline show the administrator to everyone who can read the record, or only to administrators? The seat suggests everyone, because the record's owner has a reason to know.
- The empty `ip_address` on record writes is a related gap. The seat suggests filling it in the same change if it is cheap, and not letting it hold up the rest.

Blocks nothing.
